depiction.primary_object: outlined heart shape above a horizontal bar
depiction.composition: centered heart outline resting above a thick horizontal line

ambiguity: The underline could make it look like an active-tab UI indicator or a 'download/save to favorites' symbol; otherwise functionally identical to a standard heart icon.

modifier_semantics.meaning: emphasizes, grounds, or indicates saved/pinned status
